text.Reclamation Station:
How to play ==
At any time during your turn, you may scrap a card in your discard pile. You can also scrap it to gain 3 Combat for each of your cards that you scrapped this turn, including Reclamation Station. 

Note: cards that scrapped themselves do count towards the total number of cards scrapped this turn. However, cards scrapped after Reclamation Station is scrapped do not count. 
 Strategy ==
Reclamation Station is a strong outpost with a good defense of 6. Scrapping is obviously good, but it is a shame that you can only scrap from your discard pile, which means that sometimes you don't get to scrap. The self-scrapping ability is heavily underused in practical play: when timed correctly it can really boast a lot of Combat. This does not necessarily need to be for a final blow, it can also be done if scrapping is not necessary anymore.
